title: Improper access control on an internal debug interface could allow a high privileged attacker to bypass memory access…
description: An improper access control vulnerability exists on an internal debug interface that could allow a high privileged attacker to bypass memory access controls. This bypass may lead to a loss of SEV-SNP guest memory integrity. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and does not currently have known exploits in the wild. No affected software versions or patch information are provided.
